context: 6 Synthetic Meta-Theory In this section we will show that SyNIK+Xhi extended with a cut rule can simulate NIK+X derivations under a certain interpretation of the annotations. We will then show that the cut rule is admissible in SyNIK+Xhi , thereby concluding that NIK+X rules under that interpretation are admissible in SyNIK+Xhi , i.e., SyNIK+Xhi is complete with respect to NIK+X. To formulate the cut rule with a minimum of redundancy, we will need to slightly enlarge our notion of contexts and define a pair of pruning operations for such contexts.
